results.title: Elaichi: Ek Prem Katha
results.overview: In Elaichi, the spice of desire, Sonal’s quiet domestic life explodes into nights of burning lust when a chance encounter with a younger actor turns into a frivolous sexual affair - pushing her deeper into obsession until her family, her body, and her soul are scorched by betrayal.

results.title: MORPHISM
results.overview: Eleven-year-old Kaat visits the Stavros family for the first time; a peculiar family of scientists where everyone, including the dog, suffers from a horrible wasp allergy. Blown away by the family, Kaat pushes her own boundaries further and further as an experimental subject.

results.title: GW:s mord – Styckmördaren Anders Carlsson
results.overview: Two people are searching for an injured deer at Gysinge bruk when they find a suitcase and plastic bags with dismembered body parts frozen in the ice. The victim is identified as a 23-year-old rock musician. Suspicion falls on the band's manager, who gives contradictory information. Leif GW Persson examines the murder, the investigation and the legal process.

results.title: Plastic Surgery
results.overview: A doctor on her last day before maternity leave is thrown into a world of chaos when a hidden threat emerges.

results.title: Castration Movie World Tour Anthology ii. The Best of Both a Question and a Comment
results.original_title: Castration Movie World Tour Anthology ii. The Best of Both a Question and a Comment
results.overview: A tour diary for Castration Movie part two. This hourlong collection of tour footage and live Q&As features stops in New York, Dallas, Austin, Dublin, Manchester, Birmingham, Edinburgh, Los Angeles, Sydney and Auckland. Edited by Elizabeth Purchell.

results.title: Save the Immortal
results.overview: A 20-year-old extreme sports blogger lives as if he's immortal. But he suddenly finds himself trapped in a mysterious time loop with no escape. Only a soldier who died 80 years ago can save him—but only after a young man from the future helps the soldier achieve immortality.

results.title: Fellas
results.overview: Over the course of an app date, Matt tells the story of his "Fellas," and the scandal they get into when a problematic DVD box set goes missing at their housewarming.

results.title: RIO ALMAR
results.overview: A collection of NICOLE COCHÓN & ORIANA LUCAS

results.title: Pussycat Pussycat
results.overview: When Jules and Mimi accidentally adopt a murderous cat, the lesbian couple is haunted by Pussy(cat).

results.title: Hard, on the Outside
results.overview: Anya, Mila, Aleks, and Maksym are Russian and Ukrainian immigrants settling into their new lives. We experience their everyday struggles to acclimate to life in the West while we learn with them that "a smile goes a long way" in America.

results.title: Sweat
results.overview: This gorgeous, atmospheric drama sees a rural farm worker and his emotionally charged last day with a fellow farmer in the eve of his departure.

results.title: On Defiance
results.overview: An immigrant rubbish collector awaits news of his wife lost at sea while looking after his 1 yo daughter

results.title: Huckster
results.overview: Two small-time con artists are mistaken for murder suspects and forced to stay in town to find the real killer. As strange events pile up, they uncover a mystery linked to one man’s long-recurring dream, turning a fight to clear their names into a chilling search for the truth.

results.title: Spidernado
results.overview: A quiet countryside is plunged into chaos when a monstrous tornado tears across the region—only to reveal something far worse riding in its winds.

results.title: True Love Road
results.overview: After heartbreak, Lü Xiaolong and Wen Wenwen meet by chance and road-trip across China, exposing romance scams and surviving escalating danger—until the journey leads them back to believing in love.

results.title: Carlo Acutis: The Millennial Saint
results.overview: The documentary unfolds as a journey through the life of Carlo Acutis – from pilgrimages to Assisi to digital communities around the world, up to his canonisation – illustrating the constant dialogue between earthly life and transcendent reality. It shows how the message of "the first saint of the digital age" can transcend religious boundaries and speak to different generations and distant cultures, reaching from his parish in Milan to Cascia, La Verna, Lanciano, Fátima, Rome and many countries around the world, where his words have resonated and been embraced.

results.title: Dia Bukan Syurga Raya
results.overview: The conflict between Tajul and Arham over Nuha has now reached its end, who will win Nuha's heart.

results.title: La Madame
results.overview: La Madame brings to life the director's great-grandmother, a manager of a well-known brothel in Francoist Valencia.
